title: Andreae, Chymische Hochzeit Christiani Rosencreutz, Strassburg 1616: printed secret-script inscriptions (DECODE R4502)

documents.shelfmark: Embassy of the Free Mind (Ritman Library), Amsterdam; Chymische Hochzeit, Strassburg 1616, pp. 73, 95, 97, 116; DECODE R4502

plaintext.source: The novel glosses the pp. 95 and 97 inscriptions in the following paragraphs (pp. 96, 98); Foxcroft 1690 / crcsite.org edition footnotes 12, 14, 15, 21 give all four, the sign lines as the dates 1378 and 1459.

transcription.source: DECODE R4502 public images P3-P8 (about 1450 px per opening)
transcription.notes: Letter inscriptions only; the two symbolic date lines (about 10 signs each) are described in NOTES, not transcribed. The three dotted variants for M/N/O were assigned with the plaintext in view.

system.summary: Simple substitution in an invented type-cut alphabet, words divided, for two inscriptions; two further lines of alchemical and numeral signs give dates.

diacritics.note: M, N and O are dotted variants of one base shape.

system.notes: U and V share one sign; one capital form (initial H).

prior_solution.where: The novel itself (glosses on pp. 96, 98); Foxcroft, The Hermetick Romance (1690), as footnoted on crcsite.org.

conditions.human_role: Posed the target from the catalogue; DECODE cookie already on file.

solution.what: Repo and web search for R4502 / Andreae cipher; no decipherment found under that description.
Fetched DECODE record, metadata and 8 public images; identified the item as a printed copy of the Chymische Hochzeit, not a letter.
The p.95 and p.97 inscriptions are the texts the page boy speaks on pp.96 and 98; tested as a simple substitution.
Aligned BEGRABEN, FRAW, GLUCK, FRUCHT, BAUMS etc.; built a 19-sign table consistent over both inscriptions.
DTA and 12koerbe omit the inscriptions; crcsite.org (Foxcroft 1690) footnotes all four, sign lines as 1378 and 1459.
decode.py over ciphertext.txt reproduces both German texts; date lines checked structurally against 1378/1459 (M, CCCC, IX, XX, V visible).

outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.txt: 156 cipher letters of the two letter inscriptions, all given values; the two date lines read as wholes (graded C)
outcome.notes: Not a letter: DECODE's four cipher pages are the printed inscriptions of the novel, which glosses its own two long ones. Per-sign values in the two symbolic date lines stay graded C.
